hero.title: Felipe Roa
hero.availability: Based in Sydney, open to roles
hero.slogan: Bringing a spark of **color** back to the world, one design at a time.

about.title: About me
about.bio: I'm Felipe, a designer with **8 years of experience** in art direction, UX/UI and social media. I've worked on brands like **Stellantis (Jeep, RAM, Dodge and Alfa Romeo), Capel and Banco Santander**, turning briefs into graphic pieces, content and digital experiences. After a break to travel and live in Germany and Denmark, I'm back to design from Australia.

driftler.title: Driftler – Working Holiday Community
driftler.description: A bulletin board for travellers on a Working Holiday visa: accommodation, temporary work and travel companions. I designed and built the whole product, from visual identity to code, coding with AI.

seo.title: Driftler: Working Holiday Job & Housing Board | Felipe Roa
seo.description: Case study of Driftler, a bulletin board for Working Holiday travellers to find housing, temporary work and travel mates. Designed and built by Felipe Roa.

avsa.title: AVSA Rent a Car – UI/UX Redesign
avsa.description: Redesign of a car rental website in Chiloé, focused on visual improvement and basic usability principles. It included updated content, a clearer visual identity, contextual imagery, a new FAQ module and a direct contact channel to make renting easier.

seo.title: AVSA Rent a Car UX/UI Redesign: Case Study | Felipe Roa
seo.description: UX/UI redesign case study for AVSA Rent a Car, a car rental site in Chiloé: clearer identity, a new FAQ module and a direct contact channel. By Felipe Roa.

censo.title: Usability Audit – Census 2024
censo.description: Heuristic evaluation and usability audit of the Census 2024 website, including web analysis, usability testing and the SUS scale.

seo.title: Census 2024 Usability Audit: Heuristics & SUS | Felipe Roa
seo.description: Usability audit of the Census 2024 website: Nielsen's 10 heuristics, user testing and the SUS scale. A UX case study by Felipe Roa.

ux-report.title: UX Report – Findings and Improvement Suggestions
ux-report.description: Initial review of the Carnes A Punto and Carnes a Domicilio websites to identify opportunities to improve navigation, content and architecture. It gathers key observations, competitor best practices and visual recommendations.

seo.title: UX Report for Carnes A Punto: Findings & Fixes | Felipe Roa
seo.description: UX review of the Carnes A Punto and Carnes a Domicilio websites: navigation, content and architecture findings, competitor practices and visual recommendations.
